subject: Superintendent Candidate Interviews
overview: The School Committee conducted public interviews with two superintendent finalists, Dr. Donna Straight and Dr. John Perella. No deliberations or votes took place.

items.title: Interview with Dr. Donna Straight
items.summary: Dr. Donna Straight answered questions regarding communication strategies, vocational education, special education, social-emotional learning, collective bargaining, and capital planning.

items.title: Interview with Dr. John Perella
items.summary: Medford High School Headmaster Dr. John Perella responded to committee questions regarding leadership philosophy, high school and vocational integration, standardized testing, school budgeting, and district-wide academic alignment.
